title: Causal Price-of-Risk Mandates under Overlapping Information
abstract: arXiv:2610.00158v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study whether causal risk mandates constructed from overlapping information blocks can be implemented by one self-financing portfolio that is optimal under pooled information. In an incomplete continuous Brownian market, signal-responsive exposures are projected onto traded Brownian directions and embedded as closed subspaces of a predictable Hilbert space. Each causal mandate is the attainable projection of an identified, baseline-centered intervention surface and is therefore fixed upstream of the allocator. A first exact decomposition separates non-traded structural response, incompatibility across local mandates, and distortion of the common traded book. A fusion operator corrects duplication of common risk directions. translated_title: 重叠信息下的因果风险价格委托
translated_abstract: 我们研究由重叠信息块构造的因果风险委托能否通过一个在汇总信息下最优的自融资投资组合来实现。在不完全的连续布朗市场中，信号响应型敞口被投影到可交易的布朗方向上，并作为可预测希尔伯特空间中的闭子空间加以嵌入。每个因果委托都是一个已识别的、以基线为中心的干预表面的可实现投影，因而在资产配置者上游即被固定。第一个精确分解将非交易的结构性响应、局部委托之间的不相容性以及对共同交易账簿的扭曲分离开来。一个融合算子修正了共同风险方向的重复。主要定理表明，精确的因果分权成立当且仅当：汇总扩张保持参考鞅不变、汇总最优解在加性交易台张成空间之外没有分量、局部因果……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明由重叠信息块构造的因果风险委托当且仅当汇总信息扩张保持参考鞅且汇总最优解不超出加性交易台张成空间时，才能由一个自融资组合精确实现，并给出了分离非交易结构响应、局部不相容与共同账簿扭曲的精确分解以及修正共同风险方向重复的融合算子。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that causal risk mandates built from overlapping information blocks can be exactly implemented by a single self-financing portfolio optimal under pooled information if and only if the pooled enlargement preserves reference martingales and the pooled optimum stays within the additive desk span, accompanied by an exact decomposition separating non-traded structural response, local incompatibility, and common-book distortion, together with a fusion operator correcting duplicated common risk directions.
